title: I built a social RPG where you can scan characters, pets and items into the game
author: foxql
selftext:
Hi, I’ve been working on a small social RPG for a while. In the game, you can scan items, pets, and characters with your camera and add them directly into the game.

Personally, I’m not a big fan of games where you have to sit at your computer for hours just to grind, so when you leave the game, your character keeps leveling up and interacting with other players thanks to JEV.

So even when you’re not playing, you don’t fall behind other players.

There isn’t a huge amount of content yet. Right now I’m mostly testing whether the core mechanics actually work properly.

At the end of the day, I’m trying to build something you can jump into every now and then, spend a bit of time with, and enjoy without having to commit too much time to it.

Also, all of the assets in the game, including the maps, are generated automatically through a pipeline I built. The maps were actually generated from photos I took around the area where I live :)

If you have any suggestions, feel free to share them. Unless I run into any major issues, I’m planning to start focusing on adding more content from this point on.

One last thing: idle notifications are not being sent yet. That feature was built for the mobile app, which is still waiting for Google Play review.

[https://halfreal.wtf](https://halfreal.wtf/)
